page_note: Heavily damaged page (81.8% damage). Contains a Q&A on harmful/transgressing speech and its effects, framed within an apostolic dialogue about mercy. The teaching is primarily ethical-hortatory, listing types of harmful words (killing of man, cattle, trees; evil eye; envy; accusation against brother) and contrasting with the righteous man's healing speech (wise physician metaphor). Substrate vocabulary surfaces in references to the 'cross of light' (suffering Light in matter), the 'release of the soul,' and the 'mystery of her purification' — these are core cosmological registers, but here applied ethically. Editorial fatigue score is mildly negative; per-segment scores show predominantly hortatory and ecclesial vocabulary. Oldest substrate is thin on this page.
